cases.question: What is the mode of action and IRAC resistance group of abamectin?
cases.answer: The mode of action of abamectin is a glutamate-gated chloride channel (GluCl) allozyme modulator that affects insect nerve and muscle action. Activation of glutamate-gated chloride channels after aliasing causes paralysis. The IRAC resistance group of abamectin is IRAC Group 6; Avermectins. This is supported by [D1].
